public.text: REDDHI is again described as a continuously maturing direction of travel. The chapter does not translate this into clearly defined implementation stages or observable entry and exit conditions.
public.suggestedRevision: Define measurable REDDHI maturity states or milestones without presenting REDDHI as a one-time certification. Link each milestone to capabilities, governance, conformance, coverage, data quality, resilience, and sustainability indicators.
